axis: The open northwest entry is the -X end. The horseshoe closes toward +X in the southeast.
visualScope: Panathenaic Stadium in Athens, with its open northwest forecourt, paired banks of marble seats, southeast horseshoe, historic tunnel portal, and black track around the tan infield.
limitations: The mapped seat and pitch polygons set the horizontal fit. Row heights, arena elevation, paving, flags and small details are reconstructed from the standard terrain and exterior photographs.
The track and forecourt are modeled for exterior viewing. The tunnel has an open portal and a short visible vault. The unseen passage continues outside the model scope.
